title: F24 role-obstruction discriminator
scope: Compute O_s over the corrected Step-33 final carrier using q=canonical non-abelian role and s=charge readout; test the principled O_s=0 descent predicate.
audit: run_step34.py validates corrected carrier reproduction, O_s distribution, reference status, type-limit assessment, no-tuning, source paths, and no-overclaim boundaries.
note: The predicate is nontrivial: it leaves 10 of 80 survivors and excludes 70, while the reference has O_s=1.
non_triviality_argument: The F24 obstruction is computed from each candidate's own q-fibers and charge roles; it is not a row picker and its distribution is nontrivial.
excluded_designs_rationale: Excluded designs: slot-count locks, exterior-only ansatz, larger-group recognition priors, target-shape primitives, target-support tests, minimality-only rules, and target-matched O_s values.
constraint_transfer: Gcorrected to Gf24: add O_s descent test; result redirects from intrinsic gauge filters to higher-layer descent/content-cascade or observed-input boundary.
